summary: RedCloud Holdings plc, a UK foreign private issuer listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 containing interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, a management discussion and analysis, and an earnings press release, plus subsequent-event disclosure of a July 21, 2026 at-the-market financing agreement and a line-of-credit facility. This is a routine periodic earnings filing, not a special situation; no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Risk-arb angle: none; watch ATM issuance and credit draws for dilution and liquidity.
